column1: Spent the entire evening talking to an old school friend. We laughed so much remembering old days! Best feeling ever.
I am lying awake at 3 AM with my heart racing. This constant fear of failure is driving me crazy, I can't take this pressure.
Cleaned my room, organized my study desk, and now having a peaceful cup of coffee. A very productive and calm day.
I feel like a complete burden to everyone around me. Nothing goes right, and I am losing all hope to get out of this dark phase.
Got selected for the college sports team! Everyone at home is celebrating and I am feeling incredibly proud and happy. 🏆
Just regular cooking tonight. Made some basic dinner while listening to instrumental music. Quiet and simple routine.
The stress from this software project is getting out of hand. Too many bugs, deadlines are close, and my mind is completely blocked.
It was a regular Tuesday. Went to college, attended three lectures, had lunch at the canteen, and returned by bus.
